_comment: Canned collection output for one example review window. Test fixture only; invented numbers for an invented person. Each key is a criterion measure declared by overlay_example.yaml, and expected_base_score is the anchor the rubric says that number lands on. Every measure carries the sample_size it was computed over, because a band score detached from its sample reads the same whether it came from six observations or six hundred.

median_hours_to_answer.note: Twelve requests measured end to end. Median 1.9 hours, maximum 27.1.

closed_over_created.note: 209 completed against 301 created in the window.

self_correction_share.note: Three self-corrections against two a verifier needed.

boundary_cases._comment: Each pair straddles one declared band boundary. The score must differ across the pair, which is what proves the lookup reads the bands rather than returning a constant.
